journal.text: Left before sunrise with one bag and no real plan. The city was still blue when the train pulled out, and I kept thinking I had forgotten something. I hadn't. I just wasn't used to leaving yet.
First morning somewhere new. Coffee too strong, sky too wide. I walked until my feet stopped complaining, then a little further, just to see what was around the corner.
Rain all day. I stayed in and wrote letters I probably won't send. Some days are for moving, and some are for letting everything catch up with you.
Met someone who laughed at exactly the same things. We talked until the lights went out along the water. I never learned their last name. It doesn't seem important.
Got lost on purpose and found a place that isn't on any map I own. Just light on the stones and something moving in the grass. I stayed until it got cold.
Things are starting to feel ordinary here, which I think means I've arrived. I know which bakery opens first and which road floods. Strange how quickly a place becomes yours.
Packed again tonight. It took longer than it should have, not because of the bag, but because of everything that doesn't fit in one.
Home, or whatever it is now. Everything is where I left it, and none of it looks the same. Maybe that was the point all along.
